name: Azirax
description: A simple yet extensive Discord bot that offers a wide range of commands. It also allows users to interact in creative and entertaining ways with other members of the community.

name: LiberTeis
description: A small web application that allows the management of events, materials, and spaces of the IES de Teis library, although it can be applied in other areas.

name: OBS Tools
description: A set of widgets for OBS customized for my channel and built from scratch. They were also created to practice working with different APIs.

name: GalaBot
description: A custom Discord bot for VTuber GalaYaki's server, with various functionalities such as live stream notifications or warning systems.

name: GalaCards
description: Recreation of the 'Who Am I' game prepared for 4 people and streaming. Includes a tunnel for network output and a Discord bot that manages the cards.

name: Mini Projects
description: Mini projects I create for various reasons that are so small they don't need their own repository.
